summary: Frontend-only RETEST of the 3 HIGH plain-English rendering defects from iteration_5 in the Builder Final Presentation. ALL THREE ARE FIXED. (1) Nested symbol leak: conflict #117 now renders 'The male protagonist, a wanderer, is left a fortune by the father of the male protagonist ...' and presentation-cast labels are 'Male protagonist', 'Father of the male protagonist', 'A mysterious female person...' — no bare Plotto letters (the only 'A' tokens found were the English article at sentence start / inside the BX description, plus the intentional mono symbol chip that shows the canonical designation). (2) A-clause grammar: selecting '2. A Married Person' gives present-beginning = 'Beginning · Married Person.' (leading article stripped). (3) Alias no-collapse: #1b alone renders 'The male protagonist ... falls in love with aristocratic the female protagonist' with cast A=Male protagonist + B=Female protagonist; the harder chain #1106 (B → A) + #1b also keeps the two people distinct (step1 'The female protagonist ... yearns for social prestige', step2 male + female) and the cast lists BOTH. Verified via real UI clicks on /dice, /conflict/117, /browse and /builder. Also cross-checked plottoSymbols.renderPlainEnglish/resolveCast directly in node against the live /api/plotto/characters payload (54 chars) — returns in <1ms, no infinite recursion.

ui_bugs.issue: Double / duplicated article: the renderer unconditionally prefixes 'the' to a resolved description, producing 'falls in love with aristocratic the female protagonist' (#1b) and 'will marry the a mysterious female person, or one of unusual character' (#117, BX description already begins with 'a'). Suggest: omit the leading 'the' when the substitution follows an adjective/determiner, and strip a leading 'a/an/the' from the character description before prefixing.

For the #1106 (B → A) + #1b chain the alias is now (correctly) refined away, but the step still prints 'character change: B → A (kept consistent above)' while the text is NOT re-identified — the copy is now misleading for the refined case.

issues: Cosmetic double period still present when a clause description already ends with '.' — 'Undertakes a role that leads straight to catastrophe..' (dice-loaded plot)

action_items: MEDIUM: fix duplicated article in renderPlainEnglish ('aristocratic the female protagonist', 'the a mysterious female person')
LOW: suppress/reword the 'kept consistent above' transform note when refineAlias dropped that alias
LOW: cosmetic double period in Masterplot skeleton
critical_code_review_comments: describe() + refineAlias() now correct; note Builder.js is still ~569 lines — extracting the Final Presentation block would keep it under the size guideline.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; only local builder drafts (localStorage plotto_draft_v1) created during runs. No login used.
test_credentials: not required (builder is public); admin@plotto.app / PlottoAdmin123 available
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration_5 HIGH rendering bugs are fixed and verified. Useful recipes: add a specific conflict via /conflict/<id> -> [data-testid=detail-add-to-builder], then click sidebar 'Plot Builder' link (do NOT page.goto with wait_until='networkidle' — the /api/auth/me 401 polling keeps the network busy and goto times out; use domcontentloaded or in-app navigation). Transform chain test: add 1b from /browse, then in /builder click [data-testid=option-parent-1106] (B → A). presentation-cast shows a mono chip with the canonical designation (A/B/F-A) next to the plain-English label — that chip is intentional, do not flag it as a symbol leak. During 3 of 8 runs the preview page became briefly unresponsive (screenshot/goto timeouts) right after a webpack recompile; retrying the run succeeded.
rca_of_the_issue: Remaining article defect: renderPlainEnglish emits 'the ' + describe(sym) unconditionally, without inspecting the preceding token or whether the description already starts with an article.
